summary: Baidu, Inc. filed a Form 6-K (its US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) furnishing a Hong Kong Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return dated September 11, 2026, disclosing daily on-market repurchases of Class A ordinary shares (HKEX 09888 / RMB counter 89888) for cancellation. Across September 7–11, 2026, roughly 545,000–560,200 shares were bought back daily at HKD 89.2402–92.383, totaling about 2.758 million shares, or approximately 0.025% of existing issued shares per day, leaving issued shares at 2,209,541,178. No board recommendation, advisor, or price terms beyond the disclosed average repurchase prices are stated.
